notes.title: ID Cards Patch
notes.content:
This small patch should fix the ID cards achievement. 

If you've already collected the ID cards, there's a small chance the achievement could properly fire off when starting the game. 

If not, you would have to re-do this achievement from a new game.

We apologize for the issue!

notes.title: Arabic Language + Controller Bug fixed
notes.content:
- Arabic translations were broken, and should now be fixed in this latest update.
- An input bug when playing with a controller and operating the radio's in Kane's home has been fixed.

notes.title: Tiny Patch!
notes.content:
- A few misc bugs were patched that could break certain spots of the game for a few minutes.
- Korean translation fixed in The Haven Poem
- Some players were missing key elements of a certain puzzle, which has now been clarified.

notes.title: Misc Bugs & Changes Addressed
notes.content:
- Added extra clues in the easy puzzle mode
- Fixed a few confusing notes
- Few levels have had small design updates.
- Graphics setting bug fixed
- Settings window bug fixed

notes.title: Requested New Features & Fixes
notes.content:
We have some updates for everyone!

- You can now invert X and Y axis in the camera settings window
- Difficulty settings added (Easy, Standard, Nightmare). 

Easy: Lowers damage taken from enemies, increases power of all weapons
Nightmare: Increases damage taken from enemies, decreases weapon power.

- Cleared up a few confusing areas.
- Buffed MP5 and Desert Eagle.
- Nerfed extremely fast quick-time event on glitch scraper.
- Added missing map to future prison.
- Increased notice icon visibility on a few items.
- Demo saves will no longer show up in the full game when purchased (And full game saves will not show up in a demo version either)
- Localized text on maps directly.

For our next update, we will work on achievements.


Thank you all!
- Devs

notes.title: Small Bug Fixes
notes.content:
- Combination bug in the inventory has been fixed.
- Skipping cutscene buttons improved (To avoid accidental skips!)

Our next update will include some of your feature requests.

notes.title: Launching October 25, 2024
notes.content:
"Connection: The Nightmare Within" – Launching October 25, 2024

We are thrilled to announce that Connection: The Nightmare Within will officially release on October 25, 2024! Prepare to dive into a chilling, immersive experience like no other. This game has been a labor of love, and we can't wait to share it with you.

A massive thank you goes out to everyone who participated in our playtests and provided invaluable feedback. Your support has helped shape Connection into something truly special.

Get ready to confront your deepest fears! 

The nightmare is almost here :)

notes.title: Your feedback was intense!
notes.content:
We have a new demo version out which addresses the tons of feedback everyone has given.

- Improved cutscene animations
- Combat updates which include more hit reactions to enemies, better death animations, quicker aim controls for the player, and other polishes
- Updates to various environments.
- Improved camera work for certain actions.
- Bug fixes in various areas.
- Technical issues such as widescreen support are improved
- Human translation to various languages (more to come in the future as well)

We now shift focus to finishing the final parts as quickly as possible. Stay tuned and keep giving us feedback!

notes.title: Major Milestone Update!
notes.content:
We're elated to share the thrilling news about our latest game update, a result of countless late nights and unwavering dedication from our passionate team. Get ready to embark on an enhanced gaming journey with a plethora of new features, improvements, and surprises that we've meticulously crafted just for you.

Here's a closer look at what's in store:

1. Revitalized Levels:
Immerse yourself in a visually stunning world as we've re-lit and re-colored every level, ensuring a captivating and vibrant gaming experience.

2. Diverse Enemies, Unique Abilities:
Encounter new challenges with the introduction of multiple enemy types, each wielding unique abilities that demand strategic thinking and adaptability.

3. Expanded Arsenal:
Arm yourself with a diverse array of new guns, each designed to bring a fresh dynamic to your gameplay.

4. Extended Playable Areas:
Embark on an even more extensive adventure! We've added numerous playable areas, effectively doubling the length of the game for a richer gaming experience.

5. Deeper Lore and Storyline:
Unravel the mysteries of our game with a significantly expanded narrative. We've invested time in explaining the story more thoroughly, ensuring a more immersive and engaging experience.

6. More Cinematics, More Drama:
Brace yourself for jaw-dropping cut scenes that add cinematic flair and depth to the unfolding story.

7. Crystalline Sound Quality:
Your in-game world just got an auditory upgrade! We've revamped sound quality to elevate the impact of every shot and explosion.

8. Formidable Boss Battles:
Confront two new bosses with unique mechanics, providing a challenging yet thrilling test of your gaming skills.

9. Dialogue-Rich Areas:
Engage with characters on a deeper level as we've expanded dialogue-rich areas, allowing you to become even more immersed in the game's narrative.

10. Sleek UI and Main Menu:
Experience a smoother and more intuitive journey with a revamped user interface and main menu.

11. Enchanting Musical Scores:
Let the game come alive with a suite of new music tracks, specially composed to enhance your gaming atmosphere.

12. Visual Marvels:
Enjoy improved textures, visuals, and environments teeming with intricate details and nuance.

13. Bug Squashing Bonanza:
We've combed through every nook and cranny, addressing bugs to ensure a seamless and enjoyable gaming experience.

14. Worldwide Reach:
For our global player base, we've introduced localization for different languages, breaking down barriers and making our game accessible to an even wider audience.

ːsteamthumbsupː

We're particularly proud of the progress we've made in explaining the game's story in greater detail, providing players with a deeper understanding of the immersive world they inhabit.

Your support and feedback have been our guiding lights throughout this journey. As we continue to evolve, we're committed to delivering an unparalleled gaming experience.

Thank you for being part of our community!

Stay tuned for more thrilling updates!

Best regards,
The Devs!
